result.topic_en: Riemann discusses how a fundamental system of solutions (branches y_1,...,y_n) of a linear differential equation transforms under a loop around a singular point a, diagonalizes the circuit substitution to get multipliers λ_i, introduces exponents μ = log λ / 2πi so that the branches become series in powers of (x−a), and defines a characteristic scheme P of exponents for the system.
